sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: Weather advice, typical busy times and main facilities for the sites of the journey.
sites.pending: General information, pending verification with official sources. Always follow the signs and the staff on site.
sites.offline: Weather needs a connection. It is not saved on the device.
sites.failed: The weather could not be loaded. Try again later.
sites.privacy: Only the place's fixed position is sent to the weather service, never yours.

advice.extremeHeat: Extreme heat: drink water often, rest in the shade, and use a wet towel or umbrella. Do what you can during cooler hours.
advice.heat: Hot: drink water regularly, take shade breaks and wear light clothing.
advice.uv: Very strong sun: use an umbrella or sun protection and avoid long stops in direct sun.
advice.rain: Rain is possible: the floor can be slippery, so walk slowly and keep your phone and papers dry.
advice.wind: Windy: dust is likely; cover your nose and mouth if needed.
advice.humid: Humid air makes heat harder: drink more water than you think you need.
advice.mild: No special weather advice right now.

sites.crowdNote: This is the usual pattern, not live crowd data. Real crowds can differ.
sites.facilitiesNote: Exact places change. Look for official signs and ask the staff.

busy.haram: Around the five prayers, especially after Maghrib and Isha, on Fridays and during Dhul-Hijjah.
busy.mina: The days of Tashriq and the days of stoning, Dhul-Hijjah 10 to 13. Follow the time given to your group.
busy.arafah: The whole of the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah, with many people moving after sunset.
busy.muzdalifah: On arrival at night on the 10th, and again when everyone leaves after Fajr.

quiet.haram: Late at night and in the middle of the morning, outside prayer times.
quiet.muzdalifah: Later in the night, once most groups have arrived.

ask.title: Ask
ask.intro: Ask about the journey. Answers are found in the reviewed content inside the app. This is a search, not a scholar: it never makes up rulings or supplications.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: what is forbidden in ihram?
ask.none: Nothing in the app's reviewed content matches. Try other words, or ask a qualified scholar.
ask.scholar: For a ruling about your own situation, ask a qualified scholar.
